newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN SAIT MARINE DIVISION IN MERGER.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN SAIT MARINE DIVISION IN MERGER.

text.p: Belgian radio-communications group SAIT-RadioHolland said on Friday it had reached an agreement to merge part of its marine electronics activities with two other companies.

Under the terms of the draft agreement, SAIT Marine would combine its logistics, installation and maintenance services with those of Antwerp-based AMRC NV and INES Marine NV, SAIT said in a statement. The three partners would continue to compete separately to market products.
The new company Belgium Marine Services and Logistics (BMSL) would be 70 percent controlled by SAIT.
SAIT said it hoped the new company would be operational from March 31, 1997, following agreement from unions.
SAIT is majority owned by Belgian holding company Cobepa.
